posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on Docker's MCP Catalog (DR 92). You get a dedicated page on Docker Hub and a spot in Docker Desktop's MCP Toolkit.

Here is how:

1. Host a remote MCP server for your SaaS (ask Claude to build it for you).
2. Fork https://t.co/tA0mF36XaE and run task remote-wizard. It writes a 15-line server.yaml with your MCP URL.
3. Open a PR and send test credentials through the form in their contributor guide.

A few notes:

Once it's merged, every Docker Desktop user can add your SaaS right from the MCP Toolkit. Chances are slim to get merged, but worth getting in the queue 😉
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 Docker MCP Catalog 托管 remote MCP server、fork repo 运行 remote-wizard 生成 server.yaml、开 PR 并发送 test credentials，得到 Docker Hub dedicated page 和 Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit 位置（DR92）。

posts.content:
Another free backlink hack for your SaaS: get listed on GetResponse (DR 89). You get a dedicated page linking to your site, dofollow.

Here is how:
1. Go to https://www.getresponse.com/integrations/submit-your-integration
2. Add your integration and a test login
3. Pass the review
posts.author: Rapid Indexer - Fastest Indexing Tool
posts.notes: 在 GetResponse 提交 integration 并提供 test login，通过 review，得到 DR89 的 dofollow dedicated page 外链。
